OUR STORY · SINCE 1916

Time moves on.
Some things stay.

A family. A kitchen. A tradition
carried across generations.

1916
LALA KESAR MAL JI · OUR FOUNDER
A HUMBLE BEGINNING

One kitchen.
An enduring legacy.

Kesar Da Dhaba began in 1916 in Sheikhupura, now in Pakistan. Lala Kesar Mal Ji and his wife built a small kitchen around a simple belief: good food deserves time, care and the finest traditional flavours.

That belief became a family tradition. Pure desi ghee, slow cooking and the warmth of a shared meal remain at the heart of our house.

THE YEARS THAT MADE US
1916

The first chapter

Lala Kesar Mal Ji and his wife begin serving Punjabi food in Sheikhupura.

1947

A new home

During Partition, the family relocates to Amritsar, carrying their recipes and traditions into the old city.

Today

The story continues

Under the guidance of Ramesh Kumar Mehra, with Krishnam Mehra and Krishanu Mehra carrying it forward, the family continues to welcome new generations.

TRADITION IS SOMETHING YOU PRACTISE

Every day.
Every meal.
Every generation.

THE SAME WARM WELCOME

Our history lives
around the table.

From Lala Kesar Mal Ji to Lala Shori Mal Ji and Shri Vijay Kumar Ji, each generation has cared for the recipes and hospitality that make Kesar Da Dhaba special. The greatest part of that story is still the people who walk through our doors.
